occurrence: 2026-09-23 inventory sweep, delivered 2026-09-24; original nine-day discovery window retained; saved schedule unchanged
status: domain-coverage-deployed-and-live-verified; overall workflow red on pre-existing scheduler observer timeout
discovery_notes: All 367 recent registered agents were scanned through their authorized central latest-state projections. Large per-agent history reads were attempted, with stable-global-ID retries after timeouts, unavailable cells and ambiguous friendly names. Detailed-history gaps are listed, not represented as successful reads.

Federated saved-session search returned tenant_unattributed_history across all six cells. Unattributed history was not accessed through raw indexes or alternate identities. This run covers permitted PitchAI agents, PM, code, current ingress and DNS; it does not claim access to other or unattributed tenants.

85 PM projects, all 498 tasks updated in the window (31 projects), and 47 CLI project catalog entries were scanned. 133 Git repository stores across Jeff/dev/FSN are deduplicated by Git common directory per host; cloned repositories and commit occurrences can repeat across hosts.

AutoPAR partial-clone Git inspection initially hit automatic repack failures; a read-only retry with per-command gc.auto=0 and maintenance.auto=false completed. No shared Git configuration was changed.

Fresh Namecheap snapshot contains 78 records / 74 A, AAAA or CNAME hostnames. All were compared with active/retired config and nginx ingress. Main/dev ingress was rechecked at delivery; Jeff/FSN have no installed nginx. Twenty-six recent DNS engineer/control artifacts were scanned.

New candidate strings are dominated by municipality and agriculture/open-data research corpora, vendor references, transient preview tunnels and code/escaped-text fragments. They are not all real websites. Each candidate retains an explicit disposition and source.
Waddinxveen is an active client-facing demo with normal alerts. The probe reads only the landing page and launcher; it does not open chat or submit messages.

AetherReel is an active pre-launch platform on a PitchAI-operated non-owned nip.io hostname. It is visible but alert-disabled pending release/payment/auth acceptance. No playback, login, upload, payment or model call is performed.

RSR was already retired in main; its retirement and 14-lane hotpath expectation were reconciled into staging to prevent resurrection. Its single historical state row is preserved, excluded from the active index, and not polled.

The new image is deployed in all six monitoring containers. The hosted full image test passed, then deployment rolled out before its existing scheduler-observer postcheck timed out. The same postcheck failed on the preceding main release; its last successful poll predates this sweep. A read-only 45-second feed probe succeeds while the normal 10-second poll times out. No scheduler state, timeout policy or incident cursor was changed.

After that workflow failure, the exact deployed revision passed the original database-snapshot and live-dashboard verification steps independently. This is scoped rollout evidence, not a claim that the overall workflow or scheduler observer is healthy.
